The '''HL-27 light blaster pistol''' was a small, yet powerful [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] manufactured by [[Coronet Arms/Legends|Coronet Arms]]. A superb example of the company's superior craftsmanship, the HL-27 was favored by gentry and those wanting to carry a first-rate blaster without announcing that they were armed. An excellent choice for those preferring discretion without sacrificing firepower, the HL-27 was an accurate blaster that was easily concealed; as a result it was not unheard of for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Inspector/Legends|agents]] to carry an HL-27 instead of the more common [[CDEF blaster pistol]], as the two weapons shared nearly identical range and firepower. The weapon came equipped with a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting and was sold for 450 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HL-27 light blaster pistol was mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' line.<ref name="SoF" />
